results.staff_draft:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in Project Management and Data Science at HTW Berlin. We appreciate your enthusiasm for our programme.

Regarding the application deadline, The regular application period for Summer Semester 27 has closed. The next regular application period is for Winter Semester 27/28, from 1 November 2026 to 28 February 2027 [Doc 1].

As for the required documents, please refer to our applying page [Doc 2] and [Doc 3]. You will need to submit a copy of your degree certificate, a copy of your grade transcript (with an explanation of the grading system if necessary), evidence of at least one year of professional experience after your first university degree, proof of English language proficiency, and a curriculum vitae. Additionally, you may be required to provide a letter of reference and/or a video of motivation.

The language of instruction for our programme is English [Doc 4]. Our programme takes a practice-oriented approach, with a mix of lectures, case studies, collaborative projects, and self-paced online learning [Doc 5].

Regarding the study format, according to our degree programme index [Doc 6], our Master's programme in Project Management and Data Science is classified as a full-time Präsenzstudium (presence study).

We encourage you to review our official programme page for further information on the application process and required documents.

If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us at admission-MPMD@htw-berlin.de.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

Sehr geehrte/r Bewerber/in,

vielen Dank für Ihr Interesse an unserem Master-Programm "Project Management and Data Science" an der HTW Berlin! Wir freuen uns, dass Sie unser Programm als idealen Weg sehen, Ihre analytischen Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und sich in einem dataorientierten Berufsfeld zu positionieren.

Zur Beantwortung Ihrer Fragen möchten wir Ihnen mitteilen, dass die nächste Antragsfrist für das Wintersemester 27/28 vom 1. November 2026 bis zum 28. Februar 2027 läuft [Doc 1]. Bitte beachten Sie, dass derzeit keine regelmäßige Antragsfrist geöffnet ist.

Um sich für unser Programm anzumelden, benötigen wir einige Dokumente. Dazu gehören:

* Eine Kopie Ihres Abschlusszeugnisses
* Ein Zeugnis über Ihre Englischkenntnisse (wenn nicht bereits in Ihrem Abschlusszeugnis enthalten)
* Eine Kopie Ihres Notenverlaufs (falls nicht auf Deutsch oder Englisch abgefasst, bitte auch eine Übersetzung beifügen)
* Eine Erklärung des Prüfungs- und Bewertungssystems an Ihrer vorherigen Universität
* Nachweise über mindestens ein Jahr Berufserfahrung in einem beliebigen Bereich nach Ihrem ersten Hochschulabschluss (bitte senden Sie uns offizielle Bestätigungen von Arbeitgebern oder, wenn selbstständig, Verträge und/oder Steuerbescheinigungen)
* Nachweise über Ihre Englischkenntnisse (z.B. TOEFL, IELTS, PTE Academic Test usw.)

Bitte beachten Sie, dass alle Dokumente in englischer Sprache oder einer anderen offiziellen Sprache der Universität abgefasst sein sollten [Doc 2]. Weitere Informationen zu den Anforderungen finden Sie auf unserer Website.

Wir hoffen, diese Informationen haben Ihnen geholfen. Wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben, stehe ich Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Studierendenservice der HTW Berlin

results.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in International Business at HTW Berlin. We appreciate the time you have taken to review our programme and we are happy to address your questions.

Regarding your query about applying before graduation, according to [Doc 1], applicants can apply for a Master's study programme via the application portal of HTW Berlin if they are currently in the final semester of their Bachelor's degree programme and have already registered to write their final thesis. However, please note that you must prove that you have successfully completed your Bachelor's study programme by the deadline specified in [Doc 1], which is 20 January for winter semester start or 20 June for summer semester start.

Regarding English language requirements, as stated on our official programme page [Doc 2], applicants who are not from an OECD country must provide proof of English language proficiency. We accept TOEFL test with at least 95 points for the internet-based test, IELTS test (academic) with a level of at least 7.0, or PTE academic test with at least 76 points. Additionally, we also accept comparable tests that attest to English language skills at level C1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).

Regarding application fees, according to [Doc 3], there is no additional proof of English proficiency required for applicants who obtained their qualification from an English-speaking OECD country applying for the Master's degree programme International Business. However, if you are not exempt, please note that you will need to pay the processing costs to uni-assist at the latest by the application deadline.

We also want to inform you that our Master's programme in International Business is accredited by the FIBAA (Foundation for International Business Administration Accreditation), as stated on [Doc 4].

Please find below a summary of the information we have provided:

* You can apply before graduation, but you must prove that you have successfully completed your Bachelor's study programme by the deadline specified. * English language proficiency is required if you are not from an OECD country. We accept TOEFL, IELTS, PTE, or comparable tests. * There is no additional proof of English proficiency required for applicants who obtained their qualification from an English-speaking OECD country.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

response.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your interest in the Master's programme in International Business at HTW Berlin. We appreciate the time you have taken to review our programme and we are happy to address your questions.

Regarding your query about applying before graduation, according to [Doc 1], applicants can apply for a Master's study programme via the application portal of HTW Berlin if they are currently in the final semester of their Bachelor's degree programme and have already registered to write their final thesis. However, please note that you must prove that you have successfully completed your Bachelor's study programme by the deadline specified in [Doc 1], which is 20 January for winter semester start or 20 June for summer semester start.

Regarding English language requirements, as stated on our official programme page [Doc 2], applicants who are not from an OECD country must provide proof of English language proficiency. We accept TOEFL test with at least 95 points for the internet-based test, IELTS test (academic) with a level of at least 7.0, or PTE academic test with at least 76 points. Additionally, we also accept comparable tests that attest to English language skills at level C1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).

Regarding application fees, according to [Doc 3], there is no additional proof of English proficiency required for applicants who obtained their qualification from an English-speaking OECD country applying for the Master's degree programme International Business. However, if you are not exempt, please note that you will need to pay the processing costs to uni-assist at the latest by the application deadline.

We also want to inform you that our Master's programme in International Business is accredited by the FIBAA (Foundation for International Business Administration Accreditation), as stated on [Doc 4].

Please find below a summary of the information we have provided:

* You can apply before graduation, but you must prove that you have successfully completed your Bachelor's study programme by the deadline specified. * English language proficiency is required if you are not from an OECD country. We accept TOEFL, IELTS, PTE, or comparable tests. * There is no additional proof of English proficiency required for applicants who obtained their qualification from an English-speaking OECD country.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

results.staff_draft:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for your email regarding the application process for the Bachelor's programme at HTW Berlin. We appreciate your interest in our university and are happy to assist you with your queries.

Firstly, we would like to confirm that you have EU/EEA citizenship, which means you can apply directly to HTW Berlin through our application portal. According to [Doc 1], if you have a foreign higher education entrance qualification and are not a national of an EU or EEA country, you should apply via uni-assist. However, since you have EU/EEA citizenship, we will guide you through the direct application process.

Regarding your French Baccalauréat diploma, [Doc 2] states that to apply directly for a Bachelor's study programme at HTW Berlin, you require a recognised higher education entry qualification for the State of Berlin. We recommend checking with the Berlin Senate Department for Education, Youth and Science on recognition of university of applied science entry qualifications. If your diploma is recognised, you can proceed with the direct application.

To apply directly to HTW Berlin, please follow these steps:

1. Register with Hochschulstart. 2. Apply via the HTW Berlin application portal by entering your user data from Hochschulstart (BID and BAN). 3. Prioritise your applications on Hochschulstart to ensure you are considered for a study place at HTW Berlin.

Please note that if you have any questions or concerns about the recognition of your diploma, you can contact us directly. We will be happy to assist you further.

We hope this information helps you with your application process. If you have any further questions or need clarification on any of the points mentioned above, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Regarding the VPD, the available official HTW information does not allow us to confirm whether a VPD is required for your stated qualification. We therefore cannot give a definitive VPD requirement based on the currently available official evidence.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services
